subject: Debrief & final alignment: Backend Engineer (on-call infra) — please submit scores
messages:
From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 14 Sep 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Debrief & final alignment: Backend Engineer (on-call infra) — please submit scores

Team —

Thanks again for taking the time to interview Sana Iqbal yesterday. Quick ask to close the loop: can everyone add their numeric score (1-5) and one-line rationale into the Greenhouse scorecard by EOD tomorrow (Mon 2025-09-15, 5pm PT)? I uploaded the scorecard template (scorecard-template.pdf) to the job record but pasted the guiding rubric below for convenience.

Quick rubric:
- Technical depth (systems + debugging): 1-5
- On-call readiness / incident response: 1-5
- Collaboration & communication: 1-5
- Overall fit for role: 1-5

If you think we need a short follow-up (15m) with the hiring manager for a tiebreak, drop a note here — I can carve time tomorrow late morning.

Greenhouse: https://greenhouse.io/boards/REDWOOD/jobs/8421#candidates/98123
Attachment: scorecard-template.pdf

Thanks —
David
David Kim
Senior Eng Manager, Platform
Redwood Inference

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>

Date: Mon, 15 Sep 2025 11:22:00 -0700
Subject: Panel quick-pulse + proposed next step

Folks —

I ran a quick straw poll with the on-call panel (PM + 2 SWE ICs). Results: 3x recommend hire (conditional), 1x hold. Primary gap: hands-on incident-led ownership; all agree candidate can ramp quickly with mentor plan.

Proposal: we do a 15m alignment call with hiring manager (Sana's potential manager) tomorrow 9/16 at 10am PT to confirm ramp plan and offer band before I ping Recruiting. If that time works for everyone, I can book — Calendly link below if you need to pick another slot.

Calendly: https://calendly.com/david-kim/15-min-quickcall

Also: copying the recruiting contact in case we want to accelerate background check timeline — Acme Talent Partners (hiring@acme-talent.com).

-Aditya

From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Acme Talent Partners <hiring@acme-talent.com>, Sana Iqbal <sana.iqbal@gmail.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Sep 2025 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Panel quick-pulse + proposed next step

Thanks all — consensus is clear enough to proceed with an offer contingent on the manager-aligned ramp plan.

I scheduled a brief alignment call with the hiring manager for Tue 9/16 10:00am PT to confirm level and onboarding milestones; Aditya booked the slot and invited the manager. After that call recruiting can start verbal offer + background.

Next steps (owner):
- Aditya: confirm manager alignment call happened and paste decision notes into GH (today).
- Recruiting (Acme Talent Partners): prepare verbal offer and tentative start windows (copied).
- Marissa & Lauren: add any final concerns to GH thread; we want those called out before offer goes out.

I'll loop in Talent Ops for compensation baseline after the manager confirms.

Best,
David
Senior Eng Manager, Platform
Redwood Inference
